server.test.ts validates 1.2 sync/async envelopes and rejects legacy results under 1.2. world-analysis-http.test.ts exercises real 200 and 202->worker->GET; business HTTP validates nonempty findings and every multi-round stored result.

backend.test.ts binds profile and all request semantics into hashes. Actual HTTP changes candidate or metric with the same key and receives 409 with no new job; world-analysis-http.test.ts covers profile-bound conflicts.

postgres-contract-recovery.test.ts rejects stale-generation, cancelled, expired and already-terminal 1.2 settlements without result writes. worker.test.ts covers lost leases and late completion/cancellation.
